description: This file is a shell script for testing git archive attributes and related functionalities. It includes setup commands for a git repository, various test cases for git archive operations with different options and pathspecs, and verification steps to ensure correct behavior of git archive with respect to ignored files, subtrees, worktrees, and attribute-based file selection.

methods.name: test_expect_exists
methods.description: Checks if a given file exists, expecting success by default or failure if specified.

methods.name: test_expect_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given file is missing, expecting success by default or failure if specified.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test case expecting success, with a description.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or data streams, placeholder for a custom comparison function.

methods.name: test_cmp_bin
methods.description: Compares two binary files or data streams, placeholder for binary comparison.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
